full_text:
ATTACHED TABLE — Rules on Imposition of Anti-Dumping Duties on Sodium Dithionite (Sodium Hydrosulfite) Originating in China

Suppliers of Goods Subject to Imposition and Anti-Dumping Duty Rates by Supplier (Related to Article 3)

Country of Supply: China

1. Jinhe (Jinhe Sodium Hydrosulfite Factory Co., Ltd.) and Jinhai (Yantai Jinhai Chemicals Co., Ltd.), their related companies, and persons exporting products of those companies:
   Anti-dumping duty rate: 12.87%.

   (a) Jinhe (Jinhe Sodium Hydrosulfite Factory Co., Ltd.);
   (b) Jinhai (Yantai Jinhai Chemicals Co., Ltd.).

2. Guangdi Maoming Chemical Co., Ltd., its related companies, and persons exporting products of those companies:
   Anti-dumping duty rate: 33.97%.

3. All other suppliers:
   Anti-dumping duty rate: 33.97%.

Note: Where a supplier referred to in item 3 has a special relationship with a supplier referred to in item 1 or 2 under Article 23 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Customs Act, the anti-dumping duty rate applicable to the supplier with which it has a special relationship shall apply, notwithstanding the anti-dumping duty rate for suppliers under item 3.

The exact enterprise names, tariff percentages, item numbers and related-party exception have been reproduced from the supplied Korean table. The separate HWP/PDF attachment has not been independently verified.
